title: Small directed finite-subsum presentation of a given coproduct
statement: Let X be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I an arbitrary index type, F_i module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and S a coproduct with inclusions iota_i [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist a nonempty directed preorder A in Type u (the universe of X), a functor D from A to module sheaves, and a colimit cocone with point S. For each a in A there exist a finite subset J of I and an isomorphism e from D(a) to the finite biproduct of F_j for j in J [def-sp-abelian], such that inclusion of F_j followed by e inverse and the cocone leg equals iota_j. The empty finite subset is allowed. No cohomological or compactness hypotheses occur.

source.place: Tag 01AH (colimits); finite-subsum construction in cohomology.tex, Tag 09J7, and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Constructions.Filtered. Universe reduction is the projection/section argument already recorded in the parent node proof, expanded in the docstring.

proof.text: Discard zero summands. For every nonzero summand choose an open and a nonzero section. Send its index to that open and the image section in S. Coproduct projections prove this assignment injective; the union of section sets of S over all opens is u-small, so the nonzero index subtype is u-small. The coproduct universal property is unchanged after discarding zero summands.

Shrink the nonzero subtype to B : Type u and use the finite-subcoproduct diagram on Finset B. Its transition maps extend inclusions, union gives directedness, and its colimit is S. This is the finite-subsum colimit construction, with the point identified by the given coproduct universal property.

Map each finite subset of B injectively to I, obtaining J. Reindex the finite coproduct as a biproduct over J. The induced isomorphism has the stated component equations. If all summands are zero, the single empty stage is a colimit.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_small_finiteSubsum_diagram (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type v)
    (F : I → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (S : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ι : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ S)
    (hS : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : Preorder A) (_ : Nonempty A) (_ : IsDirected A (· ≤ ·))
      (D : A ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (τ : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj S) (_ : IsColimit (Cocone.mk S τ)),
      ∀ a : A, ∃ (J : Finset I) (e : D.obj a ≅ ⨁ (fun j : J ↦ F j)),
        ∀ j : J, biproduct.ι (fun j : J ↦ F j) j ≫ e.inv ≫ τ.app a = ι j
